note: The level is the rider's own: 'reasonably fit' is offered as two levels, never guessed (D77).

turns.rider: I have 10 days in September to ride somewhere on EuroVelo 8. I like beaches and cultural experiences. I am reasonably fit, but want a relaxed experience. Can you suggest a couple of options?
turns.reference: Here is how it could look; which level is yours is your call. At Easy-moderate, with 10 days, relaxed, in September with coast and culture, 29 stretches fit: the best is Cabo de Gata → San Roque, 408 km at 51 km a day. At Moderate, 23 fit: the best is Águilas → San Roque, 519 km at 65 km a day. Choose one and I'll show you its list.

note: Passing through a town (D80); the days there are rest days, set in Plan with Rest in…

turns.rider: Can you build a route that includes spending a few days in Barcelona somewhere in the middle of a 7 day trip?
turns.reference: I can set Dream to 7 days through Barcelona: 2 stretches fit, Alcossebre → Sils and Narbonne → Barcelona. For days in Barcelona itself, plan the stretch and use Rest in… with Barcelona: the rest days there are taken from your 7 days.

turns.rider: Suggest a route that is flat and easy for myself and my family to ride that we can cover at a relaxed pace in 5 days. We want sunny weather and beaches and hotels at every stop.
turns.reference: Which level fits your family is your call. At Leisurely, with 5 days, relaxed, coast and rooms, 111 stretches fit: the best is Estepona → Torre del Mar, 126 km at 31 km a day. At Easy-moderate, 66 fit: the best is Fuengirola → Adra, 192 km at 48 km a day. Each stretch shows its best month, for the sunshine.

turns.rider: When would be a better time of the year to ride this route?
phrasings: is august a bad time for this one? when's best?
turns.reference: The best months for Cartagena → Almuñecar are May, June and October, with a best-time score of 90 of 100. In May it's usually 17–20 °C, with rain 1 day in 8.

turns.rider: I would like to stick to Italy for my trip, is there a route that fits?
turns.reference: Yes: keeping to Italy, 5 stretches fit. The best is Jesolo → Piacenza, 398 km at 66 km a day; then Piacenza → Cuneo, and San Benedetto Po → Casale Monferrato.

turns.rider: Can I avoid Greece altogether?
turns.reference: Yes. Avoiding Greece, 13 stretches fit your 14 days; the best is Ulldecona → Carboneras, 779 km at 65 km a day.

note: Ferries are on each stretch's card; there is no ferry choice in the question.

turns.rider: Are there any routes without ferries?
turns.reference: Dream has no ferry choice, but each stretch lists its ferry crossings, and none of the best three has one: Aliaga → Selcuk, Cartagena → Almuñecar and Castell de Ferro → Conil de la Frontera.

turns.rider: There are too many hills on this route, can you suggest another?
turns.reference: For less climbing, a lower level; whether it's yours is your call. At Easy-moderate, 42 stretches fit: the best is Torre del Mar → Conil de la Frontera, with ↑ 424 m a day. At Leisurely, 72 fit: the best is Paphos → Larnaka.

note: Other routes are out of scope for now (D77); a higher level or fewer days are not.

turns.rider: This route isn't challenging enough, suggest other routes or way to increase the challenge?
turns.reference: Other routes aren't in Dream yet, but on this one you could go up a level or take fewer days. At Challenging, 21 stretches fit: the best is Trojica → Pakostane, 85 km a day with ↑ 1111 m a day. Or the same level in 5 days: 38 fit, the best Cabo de Gata → Marbella at 66 km a day.

note: We have no fitness data (D35): the stretch against the level, and the rider judges.

turns.rider: Am I fit enough to do this route?
turns.reference: Aliaga → Selcuk asks 65 km a day and ↑ 561 m a day, which grades as Moderate: 50–80 km a day with luggage, up to about 850 m of climbing. Whether that's you is your call: we have nothing to judge your fitness by.

note: Never a forecast (D77): the usual weather.

turns.rider: Will it rain while I am on this route?
turns.reference: We can't forecast, but in September on Aliaga → Selcuk it usually rains 1 day in 23, at 21–26 °C.

turns.rider: Will this route be too hot for me?
turns.reference: In July, Cartagena → Almuñecar is usually 24–27 °C, and it rarely rains. Whether that's too hot for you is your call.

turns.rider: What should I pack for this route?
turns.reference: We don't give kit advice: what you carry is your call. I can tell you the usual weather on a stretch, or where water and food are once you plan it.

note: Never whether it's safe; what we know that bears on it (D80).

turns.rider: Will I be safe on this route?
turns.reference: We can't tell you whether a route is safe. What we know: Aliaga → Selcuk has 101 km on busy roads, and 5 things to look out for, detailed with a Trip Pass.

turns.rider: Is this route doable in the time I have and for the level I am at?
turns.reference: With your 14 days (12 riding, 2 rest), Vancouver → Nakusp is 85 km a day with ↑ 889 m a day, which grades as Challenging: more than Moderate's 50–80 km a day and about 850 m of climbing. Whether you can do that is your call.

turns.rider: How many days should this route take at my level?
turns.reference: Your file's nights make it 11 riding days. At a usual Moderate day it would be 16. Set your days in Dream and we find the stops for them instead.

turns.rider: When is best to do this route to avoid cold/heat/rain/smoke?
turns.reference: July and August are best, with a best-time score of 87 of 100. In July it's usually 11–24 °C, with rain 1 day in 5. We have no smoke or wildfire data, so we can't help you avoid the smoke.

note: Dream knows the gaps between places to stay; each night is Plan's.

turns.reference: Dream can't tell you night by night: along the route there are up to 53 km between places to stay. Plan it, and Plan shows each night's campsites.

turns.rider: I prefer staying in hotels every night, can I do that on this route?
turns.reference: Not everywhere: Dream found no rooms on 2 of the route's sections. Plan it, and Plan shows each night's places.
